profile.headline: Software Engineer | Mobile & Platform Systems | Scaled Products to 400K+ Users | Team Leadership & Architecture
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience leading the design and delivery of large-scale web and mobile applications. Proven technical leader with experience mentoring teams, driving cross-functional initiatives, and improving system reliability, developer experience, and release quality. Strong background in building customer-facing products used at scale, with a focus on pragmatic architecture and execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Mobile Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led development of the Relay mobile application used by 400,000+ truck drivers to manage over-the-road expenses.
- Managed and mentored a globally distributed, cross-functional mobile team, improving delivery velocity, code quality, and developer confidence.
- Led a full redesign of the customer-facing “Explore Map” used by drivers to discover locations and discounts, implementing a dynamic tile-based data streaming system with intelligent caching that significantly reduced API load, improved performance, and enabled the platform to scale as large partners such as Pilot and Love’s were onboarded.
- Simplified and hardened the end-to-end payment flow, improving reliability, security, and overall user experience.
- Designed and automated CI/CD pipelines for iOS and Google Play, enabling consistent releases with improved test coverage and build quality.
- Spearheaded the implementation of an end-to-end testing strategy, dramatically reducing production defects and increasing release confidence across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led a product team building features for a customer success platform focused on adoption measurement and churn reduction.
- Implemented a design system and reusable component architecture, improving development speed and UI consistency across the team.
- Re-architected application routing to support deep-linking across the platform.
- Led roadmap estimation and partnered with product managers to surface technical dependencies early.
- Mentored engineers and established best practices for code quality, PR reviews, and technical documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed Angular JS web application to manage patients, users, and company administrators
• Wrote and maintained ASP.NET web services API to support web and mobile applications
• Established UI styling guidelines and UX principles for web application
• Developed a transcription management solution for clinic staff to edit and process medical documents
• Developed a web schedule system for medical staff to manage appointments for providers in their system•Wrote a messenger component to allow providers to communicate with medical staff and patient’s care team
• Designed and developed dashboard UI including interactive graphs for tracking internal analytics
• Created a closed loop referral system for providers to connect to other users by geolocation
• Wrote a test harness to run historical documents through Google speech API and compare results.
• Integrated web services with third party EMR APIs to pull / push data between systems.

positions.title: Web Developer / Content Manager
positions.description:
· Develops website and implements new features using WordPress environment
· Optimizes website content for SEO / cross-browser compatibility / performance
· Administers webmaster tools / Google Analytics
· Edits and organizes images using Photoshop
